description: Create a new note at a vault-relative path. Optionally sets frontmatter and body content. Parent directories are created automatically. Fails if the note already exists unless overwrite is true (prevHash may guard the overwrite).

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing note. Defaults to false.

prevHash.description: Optional compare-and-swap guard: the contentHash from a prior read. Fails with hash_conflict if the note changed since.

name: create_note
